summary.headline: Acutaas Q2 FY27 revenue rose 42.7% YoY to Rs 4,369 mn with EBITDA margin at 40.3%; FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to ~30%.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations grew 42.7% YoY to Rs 4,369 mn in Q2 FY27, driven by the Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediate segment (Rs 4,020 mn, up 53.1%), while Specialty Chemicals fell 20% YoY to Rs 349 mn. Gross margin expanded 637 bps to 62.1% and EBITDA margin to 40.3% (up 914 bps), with PAT up 71.4% to Rs 1,231 mn. Management raised FY27 revenue growth guidance from 25% to about 30% and EBITDA margin guidance to 38-40%, and reaffirmed the CDMO target of Rs 1,000 mn... crores (Rs 1,000 crore) for FY27 and Rs 2,000 crore by FY30. Working capital days rose to 115 from 99 in Q1 on higher debtor days.

segments.name: Advanced Pharmaceutical Intermediates
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 4,020 mn in Q2 FY27, up 53.1% YoY; core pharma business grew more than 25% YoY. New CDMO contracts expected to contribute from H2 FY27. Management does not split CDMO from base business.

segments.name: Specialty Chemicals
segments.commentary: Revenue Rs 349 mn, down 20% YoY due to phase-out of legacy commodity products and a temporary BFC shipment pause after a change in ownership of a U.S. customer; shipments have resumed.

segments.name: Battery Chemicals
segments.commentary: First quarter of commercial revenue. VC and FEC commercial supply started, third product dispatched in the quarter; fourth product at pilot-scale validation. Revenue not disclosed; ramp expected over next 2-3 quarters.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to around 30% from 25%.
FY27 EBITDA margin guidance raised to 38-40%; management confirmed this applies to FY27 only, not FY28.
CDMO revenue expected to cross Rs 1,000 crore in FY27, one year ahead of the FY28 target set in Jan 2025.
CDMO revenue target of Rs 2,000 crore by FY30; CDMO EBITDA margin expected in the same range as current CDMO margins.

Full-year FY27 capex about Rs 3,000 mn; H2 FY27 capex about Rs 1,650 mn (about Rs 1,000 mn electronic-grade chemicals, Rs 450 mn electrolyte additive phase 2, rest maintenance), excluding R&D capex and land acquisition.
Electronic-grade bulk chemicals plant expected to start production in H1 FY29.
Legacy Paraben and MS products to scale down over about 1-1.5 years; MS may take longer.
capex_capacity: H1 FY27 capex Rs 1,239 mn across electrolyte additive project, pilot plant, Indicam site and maintenance.
Ankleshwar Unit 2 (CDMO): Rs 330 crore invested; utilisation 30% in Q2 FY27, expected to be no more than about 40% by end FY27; largely filled by FY28.
Indicam plant in South Korea inaugurated ahead of schedule; FY28 expected to be a ramp-up year for initial semiconductor products.
Next CDMO capex round deferred; land acquisition being planned first, with size to be decided later.
Battery chemicals plant utilisation described as very low at present.
demand_pricing: Pharma intermediate demand described as robust; cost pressures from geopolitical issues passed on to customers.
Several large generic products going off-patent; company has pre-developed intermediates for them.
Battery chemicals: industry demand exceeds supply; company cites strong order book.

Electrolyte additive pricing under long-term contracts linked to raw material and FX movements; management said realisations will be in the early teens (USD/kg basis implied) rather than the USD 30-35 spot levels cited by an analyst.
Management declined to say whether gross margin gain came from raw-material softening; said raw material prices had not softened in the quarter.
CDMO projects are all with originators, no generics; 8-10 products in pipeline; non-blockbuster products typically Rs 50-100 crore each.
Semiconductor customers targeted are in Korea, Japan and the U.S.; Indian ecosystem not yet mature.

qa_highlights.question: Revenue expected from new CDMO products in FY27, and their contribution to the Rs 2,000 crore FY30 target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management would not give product-wise revenue; FY27 Rs 1,000 crore CDMO target is backed by orders on already-validated products. Around 8-9 products to enter revenue over the next 1-1.5 years.

qa_highlights.question: Timeline for battery, semiconductor and electronic-grade chemical revenues?
qa_highlights.answer: Battery products already contributing; electronic-grade bulk chemical plant takes about 1.5 years to build, so production from H1 FY29.

qa_highlights.question: Electrolyte realisations versus recent price spike?
qa_highlights.answer: Long-term supply contracts with raw material and FX-linked pricing; management says realisations can be early teens, not USD 30-35, and it does not chase price waves.

qa_highlights.question: Will Darolutamide volumes double from the same facility, and does Ankleshwar need capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said utilisation is about 30% with room available; would not disclose wallet share or whether further capex is needed. It cannot comment on the product's market or indication expansion.

qa_highlights.question: Korea semiconductor facility: initial economics and target markets?
qa_highlights.answer: No tall commitment for FY28; revenue will be small initially with sample and pilot dispatches under way. Targets are photoresist and fab customers in Korea and Japan, not cell makers.

qa_highlights.question: Will EBITDA margin guidance of 38-40% continue into FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance is for FY27 only; the margin uplift is attributed to CDMO mix and to operating leverage as Unit 2 and battery plants scale.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin expansion to 62.1%: how much is raw material versus mix?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it cannot split the gain between raw material and mix; both contributed, and raw material prices did not soften in the quarter.

risks_watch: Specialty Chemicals revenue declined 20% YoY and remains a drag until legacy Paraben/MS exits and battery and BFC ramp up.
CDMO concentration: Darolutamide-linked volumes are a key driver, and management declined to discuss customer or product-level detail.
Working capital days rose to 115 from 99 in Q1 on higher debtor days.
Electronic-grade plant (H1 FY29) and Korea semiconductor ramp carry execution and qualification risk; management flagged geopolitical, supply chain, power and water constraints.
Margin guidance of 38-40% is for FY27 only; sustainability into FY28 is not guided.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and guidance upgrades, with a strong focus on CDMO visibility. Management was evasive and declined to give product, customer, split, or wallet-share detail on CDMO, Darolutamide, and the pharma base business, and on battery revenue.
key_quotes: Based on the current orders of existing as well as new CDMO contracts, we now believe we will achieve this target one year ahead of schedule.
Before I conclude, I would also like to revise our revenue growth guidance for current year from 25% to around 30%.
So we are not riding on some of the waves wherein price fluctuation, we don't want to get benefits from those price fluctuations or when it gets down.

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance raised to ~30% from 25%, with Q2 revenue up 42.7% and CDMO revenue expected to cross Rs 1,000 crore in FY27; backing is partial, citing CDMO contracts starting H2 FY27, a strong battery order book and Rs 3,000 mn FY27 capex, but no specific contract values or capacity numbers were given, and Ankleshwar Unit 2 runs at only 30% utilisation.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA margin guided to 38-40% for FY27 (H1 at 37.7%, Q2 at 40.3%), driven by CDMO mix and operating leverage as Unit 2 and battery plants scale; guidance is FY27 only, with no FY28 commitment.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Electronic-grade bulk chemicals plant (about Rs 1,000 mn H2 FY27 capex) to start production in H1 FY29, and Indicam Korea plant already commissioned with FY28 as its ramp year; Ankleshwar Unit 2 is only 30% utilised so no new CDMO capacity is needed near term.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guided to ~30% (from 25%) after H1 revenue rose 49.3% to Rs 7,666 mn, with CDMO revenue targeted above Rs 1,000 crore in FY27 backed by validated-product orders and battery ramp over 2-3 quarters.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: FY27 capex about Rs 3,000 mn with H2 at Rs 1,650 mn; the next CDMO capex round is deferred pending land acquisition (size TBD), and Unit 2 utilisation is only 30%, so a new CDMO capex announcement is unlikely soon, while land-led announcement is possible.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth guidance was just raised to ~30% from 25% and EBITDA margin to 38-40%, with Q2 revenue up 42.7% YoY; the CDMO Rs 1,000 crore target was pulled forward a year to FY27.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Specialty Chemicals fell 20% YoY to Rs 349 mn, working capital days rose to 115 from 99, and FY28 margin is not guided, while battery utilisation is described as very low and the Korea ramp carries qualification risk.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Around 8-9 CDMO products to enter revenue over the next 1-1.5 years, the fourth battery product is at pilot-scale validation, and the Korea semiconductor ramp starts in FY28.

rows.label: Korea semiconductor ramp (photoresist and fab customers)
rows.why: Indicam plant commissioned ahead of schedule with sample and pilot dispatches under way, but management gave no firm FY28 commitment and revenue will be small initially.

rows.label: Battery chemicals order book ramp
rows.why: Third battery product dispatched in Q2 with VC and FEC commercial supply started, and management cites industry demand exceeding supply and a strong order book, though revenue is undisclosed and plant utilisation is very low.

rows.label: Working capital days reversal
rows.why: Working capital days rose to 115 from 99 in Q1 on higher debtor days, and management gave no timeline for normalisation.

tone.note: Management was confident on the FY27 revenue (~30%) and margin (38-40%) raises and CDMO Rs 1,000 crore target, but evasive on CDMO product, customer, battery revenue and gross-margin split; analysts pressed on Darolutamide volumes, electrolyte pricing versus spot and FY28 margin sustainability.
